posts.title: Creating Time Lapse Videos with OpenCV
posts.description: This spring, my daughter Liv and I created a time-lapse video documenting the growth cycle of the wildflowers we planted in the backyard. We built a weatherproof enclosure for a Raspberry Pi-powered camera and configured it to take a photograph every 30 minutes, from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. each day, May 10th thru September 2.
